questions.question: The prophet Jeremiah wrote a scroll for Seraiah to take to Babylon. What did it say would come upon Babylon?
The prophet Jeremiah told Seraiah to keep the scroll's words to himself once he reached Babylon. True or false?
Jeremiah told Seraiah to tie something to the scroll before throwing it into the Euphrates. What was it?
After throwing the scroll into the Euphrates, what was Seraiah to say would happen to Babylon?

answers.text: It will sink and never rise again
It will fall but rise again someday
It will be rebuilt even greater
